notes: GiVo Server 1.0 (build 61) for macOS, Windows and Linux/Docker. Portal guides now deepen continuously: after each guide fetch the server keeps sweeping channels in short slices instead of waiting for the next hour, favourites and recently watched channels reported by the app are swept first, a channel that stopped answering is retried after six hours instead of a week, guides that reach only a few hours ahead are refetched sooner, and each playlist reports how far ahead its guide reaches so the app can show it on the refresh card.
